subject: Git state census spec written: branches/worktrees read model (docs/GIT-STATE-CENSUS.md, uncommitted)
result: Spec authored for the branch/worktree visibility feature the owner commissioned (nothing built yet; spec awaits adoption). FINDING: ctrl has zero git-state surface today - the feature is new, not mis-integrated. What exists scattered: aikit task cuts worktrees under <repo>/.aikit/tasks/<name> with blockers-guarded teardown and already models shared tree as the normal case; git-sync connector shells out to real git behind SYNCHRONIZER/SOURCE_HISTORY ports (the proven seam); lifecycle skills instruct inspect-before-mint with no tool backing; world_map.rs carries a dead uncommitted_edits field nothing produces. EVIDENCE BASE (2026-09-17 census of the personal root): 18 repos, ~50 worktrees, ~140 branches; O-I 10 worktrees/43 branches/19 commits on no remote/134 dirty; Quaternal-Logic 14 worktrees; legacy/Epi-Logos 14 branches all unmerged + 719 dirty.
